listings.title: 1967 International Scout 800 SUV
listings.description:
Vintage Chicago Mail Truck in GREAT condition. I purchased it from a farmer in Southern Illinois in 2011. He used it as his ranch truck. He bought it at a city auction (didn't remember the year) and kept it in a barn. Never drove it off the property. Now it sits in my garage and is a weekend joy rider.
The good:
- Original Comanche Scout motor. It is literally 1/2 of a v8 engine. They called it the "slant 4". 152 ci 3 speed with high/low 4x4
- Rebuild carb with a 2 barrel Motorcraft 5200 (Weber 32/36 clone)
- Pentronix ignition (original choke knob still on the dash, but not connected)
- Replaced hoses
- Re-cored the radiator
- new front and rear U joints
- newer shocks (previous owner)
- new water pump
- new clutch master and slave cylinders
- Switched out old vacuum wipers with modern (vintage looking) electric
- New wiper squirter
- New leaf springs
- Previous owner did a light restoration and replaced a few rusty floor boards with heavy gauge sheet metal. Body is original and virtually rust and dent free! But if you want to find some rust, you’ll find it underneath if you poke around
- Interior sprayed with bed liner
- New body bushings
- New fuel pump
- New exhaust system
- Rebuilt the front steering knuckles.
- Rewired and functional turn signals, brake lights, interior “courtesy” light and back up lights.
- It has the D27 axles front and rear, four wheel drive high and low operate. The heater works and the glass is all intact. 
- I also have a white wall spare tire and vintage rear tire mount that has not been installed (I like seeing the tail gate logo)
- The odometer reads 30xxx miles. ALL mechanics I have talked to believe the odometer has never rolled over.
- 2WD/4WD HI/Low all functional. Has original lock out hubs up front.
- Starts every time. Runs and drives great. Get's lots of smiles.
Here’s the bad:
- Needs upholstery! I have cheap seat covers on it now. The seats are all original Scout seats that are structurally sound, but new upholstery is needed.
- Time for some new brake shoes
 Gas gauge doesn’t work. Don’t you even get me started on this one. This is common on Scout 800’s. I've repaired it multiple times, but it just stops working a few days later. My new trick... fill the tank every 50 miles and you'll be fine.
International Scout made around 7000 right hand drives for the US Postal Service between 1966 and 1987 (when Jeep got the new contract). According to my research, it is estimated that there are very few survivors today (less than 200), so this is a bit of a rare bird and rather collectable for Scout enthusiasts. 
You have to know what you are getting into with an old Scout. No power steering. No power brakes. Top speed is 45mph. A super fun truck on summer days with the top off!

listings.title: 2003 MINI Cooper S
listings.description:
2003 Mini Cooper S
Very clean, 38 mpg, COLD A/C, HOT heat, Supercharged with 6 speed manual. Very fun car to drive!
Background on the car- Bought the car from a 45 year old Mini Cooper enthusiast. He was very meticulous and knew absolutely everything about a Mini Cooper a guy could know, and he had a few different Mini's. He did the normal tasteful modifications to the car for a Mini Cooper of its Era as well as maintenance too. Supercharger oil, pulley, Alta tune, Alta air filter, cat back exhuast, Cooling fan relay mod, larger intercooler. I have had zero issues with the car in the last several years ive owned it. My Wife and I just drove it out to Green Bay, WI recently (4.5hr one way; 9hr round trip). Thats how dependable and trustworthy it is... and we have 3 other daily drivers to use. I just drive it and listen to the cool supercharger noises. I dont beat on it, I never race it, I just drive it to commute around (it fits everywhere) and its fun to drive around. 
-Car is equipped with the fuel efficient 1.6L Supercharged 4 cylinder engine. Powerful and peppy powertrain for the car. The car is rated at 38MPG on the highway and around 29MPG in city type driving and it gets at least that if not better. Very smooth and comfortable car with regular maintenance completed. I bought the car about 3 years ago because I've always wanted a Mini, fun to drive, it fits in any parking spot, and the great fuel mileage. Car has mostly been commuted on the freeway and has very well maintained easy highway miles... has roughly 161k miles on it. Has newer brakes, oil change, etc recently done.
-Mechanically the car is great in my opinion considering the age. The engine runs as smooth as a swiss watch and has all of the power that it did like it was new (actually significantly more). Has no issues that would need attention (just drove it 9hrs round trip)!! The transmission shifts perfectly and nice and smooth, clutch is in good shape and it is very easy to drive. The steering is nice and tight and drives straight down the road. The brakes are powerful and responsive (newer). The suspension rides great and is tight and comfortable. Tires are still good, about 70% tread remaining. HOT Heat and COLD A/C!!!!!!
It is a 2003 Mini so with that its not perfect but miniscule such as the parking brake needs to be adjusted, the drivers window needs to be adjusted (I put a window regulator in and I didnt get it adjusted perfect but its very close), could use a valve cover gasket if you wanted but not needed right away. Id drive it to any state in the country today from AZ to FL to NY and not think twice. 
-Car is equipped nicely.... Heated seats (very hot and work great), power windows, power locks, power mirrors, Great Stereo, Navigation that does work, Map lights, rear seats fold down, CRUISE CONTROL, 6 way adjust seat, Lots of storage compartments, remote trunk release, Keyless entry, and much more that im sure im forgetting.
-The interior is in great shape and clean, no major staining. It has the rare and sought after blue leather interior. Nearly no visible signs of any type of wear on the seats, carpet, buttons etc. It really is that nice. the car has been kept perfectly clean and treated with respect. Everything on the interior works... windows, buttons, lights etc, everything.
-The exterior is clean for the year of the vehicle. Paint has a great glossy shine to it. Has no major body damage or major dents. Car was always kept clean on the outside just like it was on the inside and it shows. It does have the typical parking lot door ding and scratch/scuff... you have to look for them but they are there here or there. Minor rust bubble on the rear but nothing major or noticeable. 
Very reliable car that needs nothing but a driver. All maintenance done and is ready to go. We would drive this car across country over and over and not think twice.
Clean and clear title in hand signed and ready to go.

Subaru Introduces 2018 Forester Line with New Black Edition
New Black Edition combines distinctive style with substantial equipment upgrade
Subaru of America, Inc. introduced the 2018 Forester, highlighted by a distinctive new Black Edition that combines a comprehensive equipment upgrade with exclusive exterior and interior appointments. The Forester, Subaru's best-selling vehicle in the U.S., extends the model's 20-year tradition of delivering responsible engineering, sure-footedness and all-conditions performance, augmented in the current models with available turbocharged performance and compelling luxury.
All 2018 Forester models come standard with Subaru Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive, a distinction from competitive SUVs that come with front-wheel drive as standard and offer all-wheel drive as an extra-cost option. The Subaru Forester provides a refined, quiet ride thanks to comprehensive soundproofing measures, including an acoustic windshield.
Black Edition Dresses Up Forester
The Forester 2.5i Premium exclusively offers a new head-turning Black Edition package for 2018. The Black Edition equips this model with a significant equipment upgrade, including the Lineartronic CVT with a 6-speed manual mode and steering wheel paddle shift switches, a combination previously available only on turbocharged models. The Black Edition also comes standard with EyeSight Driver Assist Technology , X-Mode, Hill Descent Control and LED Steering Responsive Headlights.
The Forester 2.5i Premium Black Edition stands out with 18-in. black alloy wheels; fog lights with black accent trim; black finish exterior badges and mirrors; and a front grille with blacked-out wing motif and chrome frame.
The Black Edition likewise equips the Forester 2.5i Premium with a distinctive interior upgrade, including exclusive black cloth upholstery seats with simulated leather bolsters, complemented by a silver metallic and black gloss finish center dash panel. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift handle are highlighted with silver stitching, and the interior door handles feature a chrome finish. listings.title: 1966 Ford Mustang GT Fastback
listings.description:
Own a piece of automotive history with this authentic 1966 Ford Mustang GT 2+2 Fastback. A true survivor vehicle, it features its original A-Code 289 CID 4BBL V8 engine paired with a classic 4-speed manual transmission. Carefully maintained within a private collection for over two decades, this vintage muscle car combines incredible originality with reliable performance.
The exterior is dressed in a factory-correct Turquoise Metallic paint finish applied over 20 years ago, highlighting excellent chrome accents, trim, and all-original glass. Inside, the cabin features the iconic original turquoise-and-white Pony Interior, complete with comfortable bucket seats, a full center console, a convenient fold-down rear seat, rally pack gauges, and a factory tachometer. All interior lights and the clock remain fully operational.
Further adding to its charm, this classic fastback includes a Cobra engine dress-up kit, an unmodified trunk and undercarriage, classic rally wheels, and a preserved 1979 Georgia State inspection sticker pointing to its rich Southern heritage. Freshly serviced with a new fuel tank, fresh fluids, a professional tune-up, new tires, and a replacement battery, this vintage Mustang GT Fastback is completely ready to drive, show, and enjoy. 2011 Audi S4 (B8) – 6-Speed Manual 
Miles: 215,000+ Price: $6,900 OBO
Selling my 2011 B8 S4 6-speed manual. It has over 200k miles and some exterior flaws, but mechanically still strong. Selling to downsize my garage, but every time I drive it I get second thoughts. Car interior is very clean and comfortable and it's a blast to drive.
Highlights:
* 6-Speed Manual
* APR Stage II pulley and tune (previous owner said 440hp, I'll claim 400+)
* B8.5 exhaust swap with center res delete + ECS X-pipe (like it since it let's everyone know it's not stock under the hood)
* Bang&Olufsen sound system
* Interior is in really good shape, includes WeatherTech mats
* Includes two wheel sets: black aluminum summer wheels + stock wheels with winter tires
* Have the straight pipes that came on the car when I purchased if interested
Maintenance:
* New clutch replaced ~20k miles ago
* Wheel bearings replaced ~20k miles ago
* Full synthetic oil changed every 6 months regardless of mileage
* Always Premium gas
Needs:
* ABS and TPMS lights on (scanned code reads faulty wheel speed sensor)
* Small hole in the oil pan was JB-welded. It's sealed and holds oil fine, but pan should be replaced at a future oil change.
* Body has cosmetic flaws: passenger rear quarter panel dent (door seals fine), discolored front driver fender, scratching near hood latch, rust spot on trunk lid under driver taillight.
* Both a suspension fault and sport differential system faults trigger on startup.
It's a 15 year-old German car with 200k+ miles. I'm trusting you know what your getting yourself into. The proceeds of this sale are going into my E39 540i, so that's what I'm getting in to.
Runs fast, drives great, perfect driver and it loves to be driven. 
$6,900 cash OBO. Located in Burnsville.

listings.title: 2015 Chevrolet Express 3500 Cargo High Country
listings.description:
Up for sale is our Silver 2015 Express 3500 HD Cargo Van. We purchased it brand new on 6/15/15 from Castle Chevrolet in Elk Grove Village. We recently purchased a new van so this one is now up for sale. It has served us well and has a ton of life left. This van is now ready to go to work for its new owner.
Immediately after purchasing the van it was upfitted with a roof top ladder rack. At the same time the rear cargo area was upfitted with a shelf / storage system. There is also a box that extends from the cargo area into the cabin. We used this for storing 10’ lengths of conduit & strut however I am sure it has many other uses. All of the upfitting of the van is included. The roof top ladder rack as well as the bulk head and shelving system go with the van. This is a great savings for the next owner as it is quite expensive to purchase all of these parts new. The buyer should know that all the upfitted items are able to be removed if they are not required for their application.
Throughout the time we have owned it, keeping it running and operating properly was our main concern. Oil changes were always performed on a consistent basis. When maintenance or repairs were required, they were done professionally.
Recent maintenance and repairs include: 
Idler Arm, Pitman Arm, Shock Absorber & 4 Wheel Alignment – 6/26 - $2,011.63
Alternator & Battery – 11/25 - $1,029.92
Ceramic Rear Pads, Rotors, Brake Fluid Flush & New Tires – 10/24 - $1,894.74
The van currently has 155,153 miles. The 4.8L V8 engine runs great and the interior is in exceptional condition. It has power windows, a rear view camera, cold AC, hot heat and radio works great. It also has a clean and clear title. 
When you consider all of that, I am sure you can tell this Express 3500 Heavy Duty Cargo Van is ready to serve its new owner for many years to come.
The van can be seen Monday through Friday between 8am and 1pm. 
Thank you for looking and God Bless America!!

listings.title: 2002 Nissan Pathfinder LE
listings.description:
This rare find has 75,357 miles and there is no rust. It's all original sheet metal, not a repaint. The interior still smells new. I purchased the truck as a project and I did a stupid amount of stuff to it. I have all receipts. I bought it two years ago. First thing done was the engine cradle replaced and the rear main seal. I then replaced all suspension components, struts, shocks etc. Replaced brakes all around / new front axles / new front hubs, bearings, seals / new ABS sensors / new ABS rings. New Firestone tires (less than a thousand miles on them). Replaced belts / serviced all fluids as needed. New red top Optima battery and also a new starter. It runs, drives, shifts and stops like a new car. Honestly, it's impressive. I wanted to turn it into an overlander so I could ride off into the dystopian grey sunset after AI and the robots take over the planet but never got that far. It would make a cool overlander. 
Everything works. It's the LE so it's got all the bells and whistles offered at the time. There is one small tear on the center armrest less than an inch long but otherwise interior is flawless. It's got a nice aftermarket stereo in it with a screen. 
I have probably forgotten some of the other things replaced or repaired but you get the idea. When I bought this vehicle I intended to keep it for the rest of my life (I'm old and thought maybe I could pull it off) but things have changed and I now hope to find someone who can genuinely appreciate it the same way I do. The price is 10,000 FIRM, as in non-negotiable, don't even ask. Sadly, I'm in this vehicle for significantly more than 10k but I'm also a realist. You'd be hard pressed to find a nicer old school R50 Pathfinder anywhere for the money.

listings.description:
For sale is a 2008 Mini Cooper. I am the second owner. I've owned it since 167,000 miles.
Look at known issues below. It is not a perfect car, but it's enjoyable to drive. I've enjoyed it two summers. But I am the only one in my family that can drive stick and we need a car that is automatic that we all can share.
I frequently drive this car between Eau Claire, Menomonie, and the Twin Cities. I drive this car pretty conservatively, so I am getting consistently 45 mpg with it. It takes premium gas.
Recently replaced:
• spark plugs
• rear brakes, rotors, and calipers
• oil change about 1,500 miles ago
Known issues:
• oil leak - needs a quart of oil every 1,000-1,500 miles
• exhaust leak - it makes a little noise, and when the heat is on and you're sitting at a stoplight you can smell a little bit of it (I just turn the heat off if the car is idling for a while)
• passenger power window is finicky - it works fine, but it can't go all the way up sometimes--you have to work it up gently
• air conditioning does not work - it has not work for about two years - I never looked into it
• tires - the back two tires leak air, one more than the other - I usually have to air them up once a week
• driver's seat has wear and is torn
• center console information display (time, audio input) sometimes is faded and can't see it

Selling my 2011 Tacoma TRD Access Cab 6-speed manual 4WD. It has been my dependable driver and I'm sad to see it go. Originally a Nevada truck when I purchased it in 2021, so the frame is in great shape with only surface rust —cleaner than most MN trucks of this age. Selling for a vehicle with more people-carrying capacity and consolidate my vehicles.
About:
4.0L V6 paired with a rare 6-speed manual transmission 4WD
Brand new clutch installed ~15k miles ago
TRD Package with rear Access Cab jump seats 
Bed Rail system and liner
Installed trailer brake controller
Clean interior, well taken care of
Solid, clean frame underneath (Nevada truck origin)
Regular oil changes every 6months, full synthetic. Last one in August 2026, ~2k miles ago.
Tires have about 20k miles on them, still rubber left.
Needs:

May need standard maintenance just due to age, but it runs and drives fantastic.

listings.title: 2010 Lexus RX450H awd
listings.description:
Selling my 2010 Lexus RX 450h AWD hybrid SUV with approximately 167,000 miles. Black exterior, clean title, and originally a California vehicle.
The vehicle runs and drives normally. It has a known hybrid battery issue, detailed below, which is reflected in the asking price.
I've already purchased a larger vehicle and don't have the space to keep both. I also don't have the time to address the remaining repairs, so I've decided to sell as-is.
FEATURES
3.5L V6 hybrid engine with all-wheel drive
Factory navigation system
Backup camera
Heated and ventilated leather front seats
Power sunroof
Keyless entry and push-button start
Dual-zone automatic climate control
MAINTENANCE WORK DONE
2022 – Engine replacement and major mechanical work: Following a catalytic converter theft that resulted in damage to the coolant lines and subsequent engine overheating, the gasoline engine was replaced with a used engine from a 2011 Lexus RX 450h with approximately 92,000 miles at installation. Extensive mechanical work was completed as part of the replacement. The engine has performed reliably since, including during a cross-country drive.
February 2026 – 12V auxiliary battery replaced.
June 2024 – Both rear shock absorbers replaced.
June 2024 – Catalytic converter anti-theft protection installed.
June 2022 – Exhaust system repaired following catalytic converter theft.
Regular synthetic oil changes - will need one soon.
May 2026 – Passed Illinois emissions testing.
Maintenance and repair documentation available.
CURRENT CONDITION
The vehicle runs and drives normally, with no noticeable performance issues.
Exterior: Normal wear consistent with age. Originally a California vehicle, with no significant visible rust observed.
Interior: Normal wear for its age, including some minor tears in the driver's seat.
Tires: Low tread and will need replacement.
HYBRID BATTERY ISSUE:
The vehicle intermittently triggers diagnostic code P0A80 (Replace Hybrid Battery Pack), approximately every few days.
The warning is cleared using an OBD scanner but eventually returns. The vehicle continues to drive normally, including when the warning appears, without noticeable changes in performance.
I am not sure whether the battery itself needs replacement or if there is something else causing the issue. Either way, the car drives fine and I clear the code with a small scanner that plugs in via Bluetooth. You can do it while driving as well. 
PRICE & SALE DETAILS
Asking $4,000 OBO.
Clean title. Maintenance and repair records available.
Vehicle is being sold as-is, with the known hybrid battery issue.

listings.title: 2011 Infiniti G25X Sedan
listings.description:
We spent 4 months looking for a clean G25 just to get rear ended 5 days later. No rips or tears on seats and interior is like new. The insurance company totaled it out and I’m debating on keeping it. It was a high hit so the rear body panel may be salvageable. Quarters look good. Needs a deck lid, bumper and lights. The foam absorber does not appear to be damaged. The underside is clean with minimal rust and everything still works as it should. It would make a really nice repairable for a guy with a smaller body shop. 
It will be for sale until Monday and if nobody wants it I’m going to probably just let the insurance company come and take it as I do not have the time right now to fix or wait for a buyer. It is still drivable as the airbags did not deploy and it still drive straight and fine based on the 50 miles or so that we drove it since the accident. Drive at your own risk however. 
We would have to write up a bill of sale and then when I get the plates and title from the state we can meet up and I can give them to you. 
I included a portion of the Carfax but due to Facebooks photo limitations it’s not complete. I can provide interested buyers a copy if interested. The title is currently clean and the insurance company advised state law says it’s below the total loss threshold, however, it may still show as a total as the insurance company feels it would cost more to repair it than to just pay the value for it. The title currently shows clean.
